{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -999: {data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean():.2%}")

# Drop rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline
data_clean = data_dedup[data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check assay_batch B: convert biomarker_final to ng/mL (divide by 10)
data_clean.loc[data_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Verify the transformation
test_batch_b = data_clean[data_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final for batch B after correction: {test_batch_b:.1f} ng/mL")"}
